name: Amazon
tagline: Every interviewer scores Leadership Principles alongside coding

values.name: Customer Obsession
values.meaning: Start from the customer and work backwards.

values.name: Ownership
values.meaning: Act for the long term and for the whole company, not just your task.

values.name: Dive Deep
values.meaning: Know the details, audit often, question odd metrics.

values.name: Bias for Action
values.meaning: Move fast on reversible decisions and take calculated risks.

values.name: Learn and Be Curious
values.meaning: Keep learning and explore new possibilities.

values.name: Deliver Results
values.meaning: Ship quality work on time despite setbacks.

values.name: Earn Trust
values.meaning: Listen, speak candidly, and critique yourself openly.

values.name: Invent and Simplify
values.meaning: Find new ideas and keep solutions simple.

loop.focus: About 70 min coding plus a 15 min workstyles survey tied to LPs.
LeetCode easy-medium coding with working, tested code.
Two or three LP stories per interviewer in STAR form.
Outside interviewer guarding the hiring bar, can block an offer.

behavioral_themes: Going beyond the ask for a customer
Owning a mistake and fixing it
Digging into a confusing bug or metric
Learning a new tool under deadline
Disagreeing with a teammate or lead
Missing a deadline and what changed
coding_style: Syntactically correct code, no pseudocode, usually without an IDE; data structures and algorithms at easy to medium level. Graded on working, robust code with edge cases and invalid input handled. Interviews often split time between LP questions and the coding problem.
rubric: Leadership Principles, each interviewer assigned specific LPs
Bar Raiser: raise the bar vs current hires
question_themes: Tell me about a time you owned something end to end
Tell me about a time you used data to decide

panel_flavor.manager: Maya asks LP stories on Ownership and Deliver Results and wants the result in numbers and what you personally did.
panel_flavor.tech: Theo opens with an LP like Dive Deep, then a coding problem; he wants compilable code and asks how it fails on bad input.
panel_flavor.skeptic: Sol is the Bar Raiser for real: they map every answer to a named LP, drill follow-ups until they hear I not we, and ask for metrics.

uncertain: Exact intern interview count after the OA; reports range from one to three
Whether a Bar Raiser sits on every intern loop
Which LPs are assigned to intern interviewers
